kpi_specs.name: Total Revenue
kpi_specs.description: Sum of all transaction amounts (Total) to measure overall business performance.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT SUM("Total") AS total_revenue FROM data
kpi_specs.reasoning: Total revenue is a fundamental KPI for any retail business, providing a single summary metric of financial performance.

kpi_specs.name: Revenue by Country
kpi_specs.description: Sum of transaction amounts (Total) grouped by billing country to identify top markets.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT "BillingCountry", SUM("Total") AS revenue FROM data GROUP BY "BillingCountry" ORDER BY revenue DESC
kpi_specs.reasoning: Revenue by country helps identify geographic markets contributing most to sales, suitable for a bar chart due to the categorical nature of countries.

kpi_specs.name: Monthly Revenue Trend
kpi_specs.description: Sum of transaction amounts (Total) grouped by month to analyze revenue trends over time.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', "InvoiceDate") AS month, SUM("Total") AS revenue FROM data GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
kpi_specs.reasoning: Tracking revenue over time is critical for identifying seasonal patterns or growth trends, best visualized as a line chart.

kpi_specs.name: Average Purchase Value by Customer
kpi_specs.description: Average transaction amount (Total) per customer to assess customer spending behavior.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT "CustomerId", AVG("Total") AS avg_purchase_value FROM data GROUP BY "CustomerId" ORDER BY avg_purchase_value DESC
kpi_specs.reasoning: This KPI provides insights into customer spending habits, useful for segmentation. A table is appropriate for detailed customer-level breakdowns.

kpi_specs.name: Top Genres by Revenue
kpi_specs.description: Sum of transaction amounts (Total) grouped by primary genre to identify the most popular music genres.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT "primary_genre", SUM("Total") AS revenue FROM data GROUP BY "primary_genre" ORDER BY revenue DESC
kpi_specs.reasoning: Understanding revenue by genre helps tailor inventory and marketing strategies, with a bar chart effectively comparing categorical genre performance.
